column1: # predicates.tsv — the closed, versioned predicate vocabulary for `assertion.predicate`
# (PLAN.md J.1, J.2). "Closed because an open predicate vocabulary makes the knowledge graph
# unqueryable within a year; versioned because it will need to grow" (PLAN.md J.2). This file IS
# that vocabulary's version 1 (the "Initial set" named in PLAN.md J.2); adding a predicate later
# is a new row plus a version bump recorded in this file's own history, never a free-text value
# biolink_mapping / ro_mapping (Biolink Model predicate / Relation Ontology term): PLAN.md J.2
# says the vocabulary is "mapped to Biolink and RO where an equivalent exists" but does not name
# the specific mapped terms. This curator does not have a checked mapping for any of the 17
# predicates and is not confident enough in a from-memory Biolink/RO CURIE to assert one --
# guessing a specific ontology term id here would be exactly the "mapped to the nearest plausible
# match" error docs/reference/CONVENTIONS.md "Identifiers" forbids for external identifiers. Both
# columns are left NULL (empty) throughout, for a curator to fill in with a checked mapping.
#   predicate            the closed vocabulary value (PLAN.md J.2)
#   subject_type_hint    the PLAN.md J.1 `subject` reference type(s) this predicate is typically
#                        used with (gene_group | strain | reaction | pathway | modification | ...)
#   object_type_hint     the typical `object` reference type or literal-with-units kind
#   biolink_mapping      Biolink Model predicate CURIE, or empty (NULL) — not yet assigned
#   ro_mapping           Relation Ontology term CURIE, or empty (NULL) — not yet assigned
